title.rendered: Bosley Hair Products Reviews vs Kiierr

Hair Loss Reasons

Hair loss occurs due to a number of reasons and varies from person to person. These include:

  • Hypothyroidism

  • Cicatricial alopecia

  • Trichotillomania

  • Traction alopecia

  • Androgenetic alopecia (for both male and female)

Hair loss may be a genetic trait but it is not necessarily an inherited feature from your maternal grandfather. Medical science claims that hair loss genes come from both sides of the family and can affect both males and females.

Hair loss genes have an unpredictable pattern, they can skips generations or affect siblings totally at a random picking. As mentioned above, there are varying causes of hair loss and it is always advisable to discover the root cause of your hair loss before you settle for a treatment option.

Several products for hair loss line the supermarket shelves and it can be quite difficult to determine which would suit you best. We are going to discuss two different brands to compare and contrast the products they offer. Keep reading to learn more about Kiierr vs Bosley hair products.

Bosley Hair Products Review

Bosley hair growth products cater to hair loss problems with a line of products. Apart from hair loss products, they also offer products to protect colored hair from damage and hair loss. Let’s look at some of their products:

1.    Hair Supplements for Women

Bosley offers dietary supplements of both men and women with designated formulas. For the women, they offer hair supplements containing necessary vitamins, nutrients and minerals that regulate healthy hair growth.

The supplements contain cysteine, riboflavin, copper and horsetail extract. All these ingredients contribute to a healthy growth of strong hair, as well as vitalize your skin and nails.

2.    Bosley Laser Cap (Revitalizer) Review

Bosley created a medical device that earned the clearance by FDA for treating genetic hair loss. This device employs the low level light therapy technology and is available in three different laser cap options.

You can choose between a laser cap that contains 96, 164, and 272 laser diodes. The products range in price from $799 to $2,079 depending on which device you decide to purchase.

The clinically proven LLLT technology that the device features ensures maximum treatment coverage, stimulates your dormant hair follicles and reduces the percentage of your thinning hair.

3.    BosRevive Kit (Non Color Treated Hair)

The kit by Bosley features a range of products that are primarily sulfate-free and gentle to use. These products successfully clean your scalp, removing and breaking down harmful toxins that stunt your hair growth.

If you have a scalp surface where thinning hair is quite visible, this kit is a great treatment option for you.

4.    BosRevive Kit (Color Treated Hair)

This revive kit caters to the color treated hair with their sulfate-free and gentle to use products. The products in this kit recondition and rejuvenate color treated and fragile hair and scalp. The LifeXtend complex formula blocks the build-up of DHT and offers you anti-aging protection.

The products protect and extend your hair color while treating your hair loss problem. Many people have re-grown thicker, fuller and healthier hair with this 3-step revive kit.

How Do Bosley Hair Growth Products Work?

According to the Bosley website, Bosley laser caps deliver clinically proven low level light therapy (LLLLT) through auto-programmed treatments to help stimulate new growth among the hair follicles on the scalp and reduce the overall thinning. The LLLT stimulates cellular activity and blood flow to the scalp tissue to encourage new growth.

The Revitalizer laser caps emit the low level light therapy at a 650 nm wavelength, which is the standard wavelength for FDA-cleared laser caps on the market. Individuals must be 18 years of age or older to use the laser hair cap products.

Bosley Hair Growth Products Cost

As previously mentioned, Bosley offers several different products depending on what you are looking for. Therefore, Bosley cost of products also vary. They range from $17 to $1,279. The cheapest product being the BosleyMD BosVolumize Volumizing & Thickening Nourishing Leave-In, and the most expensive being the Bosley Revitalizer Flex 272 laser cap $2,499.

Comparing Bosley Laser Cap Reviews vs Kiierr

Now we will compare Kiierr vs Bosley reviews.

Bosley’s and Kiierr’s products aim to address your hair loss problems that are not secondary to any underlying serious medical conditions. However, Kiierr made it so convenient for just about anyone to enjoy the maximum benefits of the LLLT technology.

The main difference is between the price of the laser cap devices that both Kiierr and Bosley sell to their customers. Bosley products are significantly more expensive than Kiierr’s, especially for laser caps that contain the same number of laser diodes. For instance, Kiierr’s 272Premier laser cap costs $845 where the Bosley Revitalizer 272 costs $2,079.

Previously, only clinics had access to this tremendously technology and so people had to suffer length processes and repeated visits for their hair problems. With Kiierr’s wonderful products, you not only get the best technology treatment for your hair loss problems, you can also kiss that hair loss of yours goodbye.

Kiierr Hair Products

Kiierr hair products are life changing and many clients, both males and females, have grown back thicker, fuller hair after using Kiierr’s hair loss products. Below you will learn about each in detail.

1.    Kiierr Laser Hair Cap

Laser caps are by far the most powerful and effective hair loss product that Kiierr offers. They treat thinning and balding hair while overturning and reversing hair loss. With FDA clearance, laser caps effectively and safely promote healthier and thicker follicles.

You can benefit tremendously from the LLLT technology in the laser caps that have the approval of notable medical professionals and scientists from around the world. The technology boosts your blood flow and energy and reactivates the hair follicles.

Kiierr offers three different laser caps for customers to choose from. These caps contain 148 and 272 medical grade laser diodes, and one cap is XL in size for individuals with a larger head. These laser caps contain all medical grade laser diodes and no LEDs.

Prices range from $645 for the most basic cap with 148 lasers, up to $1,545 for the 272PremierMD laser cap. However, the most popular cap is the 272Premier laser cap, containing 272 medical grade laser diodes. This cap alone costs $875 and if customers want the added shampoo, conditioner, and vitamins, the cost is $955.

Customers typically report hair growth within 6-8 months and the treatment therapy is completely hands-free and pain-free!

2.    Biotin Gummies

Kiierr’s biotin gummies contain the goodness of essential vitamins, coconut oil and Elderberry to help promote successful hair growth. We are all aware of the importance of biotin for our hair health, which is why studies suggest that a deficiency of this component can cause hair loss.

The biotin gummies also restore your keratin infrastructure, another crucial element for strengthening and making your hair glossy and shiny.

3.    DHT Blocking Vitamins

DHT contributes widely to hair loss. Kiierr’s DHT blocking vitamins do what the name suggests in addition to promoting hair growth and circulation in your scalp. Saw Palmetto, horse extract and zinc formula make up the composition of the vitamins.

The most powerful ingredient in this is the Saw Palmetto that effectively blocks the conversion of 5-AR enzyme into DHT. These vitamins are made with completely all natural ingredients.

4.    Hair Growth Conditioner

The two active ingredients, namely Derma Pepanagen-S and Trichogen VEG LS 9733, regulate a healthy and active hair growth process for you. This conditioner is a fine product for replenishing and moisturizing your hair while maximizing the anagen phase.

Kiierr’s hair growth conditioner also contains peppermint essential oil, which helps circulate blood flow in the scalp to encourage new hair follicle growth.

5.    DHT Blocking Shampoo

The enzyme 5a-reductase catalyzes the conversion of testosterone to DHT and could be a major cause of hair destruction. Kiierr’s DHT blocking shampoo is the best product for blocking the excessive conversion of testosterone to DHT, which in turn sustains your hair health.

The aforementioned proteins, vitamin E and pro-vitamin B5, jojoba oil, keratin, and the Collagen amino acids block the effects of 5a-reductase, thereby regulating your sebaceous glands activity and delaying or maybe even reversing hair loss.

 

Conclusion: Bosley Hair Products Review vs Kiierr

Hair loss is a menace for both men and women. A variety of reasons contributes to causing hair loss and may happen to a younger group of people as well. We hope you gathered the information needed from this in depth comparison guide between Kiierr vs Bosley hair products.

Based off the information provided above, we recommend Kiierr for all your hair loss needs! From laser caps, to the fabulous supplements, you can feel confident that your hair is getting the best treatment available. Start your hair growth journey with Kiierr today!
